This looks like late 2024. The fed funds rate is 4.83%, which fits after the September 2024 cut, and a 0.50 drop over 3 months and 12 months fits a 50bp cut in September. The unemployment rate is 4.2%, and 3-month average payrolls of 116k fit a period after the weak summer data.

Headline CPI at 2.59% and core CPI at 3.27% fit August 2024 (headline 2.5%, core 3.2%). The 2-year yield at 3.55% and the 10-year at 3.75% fit late September 2024 (10-year about 3.8%, 2-year about 3.56%). The VIX at 16.96 is also close to the late-September level.

A fed funds rate of 4.83% is the September monthly average (4.83). The 12-month equity return of 35.7% fits September 2024 (S&P up 36%). Gold up 40% over 12 months fits too, and so does emerging-market equity up 6% in the month (China stimulus).

CPI would be the August figure, published in September. The 3-month change in the 10-year yield of -0.61 is consistent with June 2024 at about 4.36%.

The snapshot is September 2024.
